notes.title: 【peakvox Escape Virus HD】Ver1.2 Update Notes
notes.content:
Updated to Ver1.2.

Virtual full screen (borderless window) support
Game resolution can be set to the display resolution in Window mode.
Optional language switching (Japanese/English)
Mouse button support
Added “Chippy and Noppo” to PR.
Updated credits
Updated Steam SDK
Other convenience improvements

tags.feature: Game resolution can be set to the display resolution in Window mode.
